verdict.rationale: Render documents official SDKs for TypeScript and Python, but both are scoped to Workflows: defining tasks, registering them via `task()`, chaining runs, and triggering runs from your own code. The evidence shows no general-purpose SDK for managing services, datastores or deploys. The REST API and OpenAPI spec are building blocks, not SDKs, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: SDK coverage beyond Workflows (services, deploys, datastores), SDKs for other languages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Render SDK for TypeScript provides support for: - Defining workflow tasks - Triggering runs of those tasks from your other TypeScript code
The Render SDK for Python provides support for: - Defining workflow tasks - Triggering runs of those tasks from your other Python code
Use `task()` to register a provided function (`func`) as a workflow task with the specified `options`.
Chaining additional task runs from within a task function
